## Checklist
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] UI: `npm run check` and `npm test` pass (if the UI changed), with screenshots
- [ ] Public items documented; `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] Every hardware assumption is marked `HW-VERIFY` and listed in `docs/hardware-testing.md`
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
